Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-10-22

1. OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
OpenAI’s latest frontier models and Codex coding workflows are now listed in Gemini’s Model Garden, a curated collection on Google Cloud Marketplace.

2. How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
OpenAI engineered a novel, large‑language‑model (LLM) driven ad stack that interprets user prompts, classifies intent, and serves contextual ads without mixing them with the AI’s responses. The system uses a dedicated “ad‑mode” LLM, strict content segregation, and real‑time relevance scoring.

3. Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
Anthropic unveiled Claude Duet, a new app that integrates its Claude‑3 models into a dedicated agent‑focused interface. Access is limited to users on the Pro and Max subscription tiers, who can join a waitlist to get early entry.
